subject.title: feat(android): accept audio and document attachments via share sheet and composer

question: Should OpenClaw ship this curated audio/document intake as bundled Android behavior once the gateway-safe limits and user-visible timeline behavior are corrected?
rationale: This is a new bundled mobile capability with MIME-scope, sandbox-limit, and support-surface implications; code review can identify defects but cannot choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped feature
options.body: Keep the curated MIME set, require the listed correctness repairs and real Android proof, then merge as a supported Android attachment path.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Limit the initial release to attachment kinds whose gateway staging and timeline presentation are already fully supported, then track the remaining types separately.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Pause the feature until maintainers choose the supported Android attachment policy and its upgrade/support commitments.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped feature
recommendation.body: Keep the curated MIME set, require the listed correctness repairs and real Android proof, then merge as a supported Android attachment path.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history ties this contributor to the Android attachment design and implementation, making them the closest available routing candidate.
